externallyProvisioned.description: STOR-14. Optional, defaults to false. True means THIS SERVER IS YOURS, NOT NPDEV'S: NPDev did not start it and must never start, stop or destroy it, so the generated _ops toolbox refuses Create/Start/Stop/Reset and reports reachability instead of container state. Orthogonal to schemaLifecycle.ownership, which is about the SCHEMA (whether NPDev issues DDL) rather than the SERVER (whether NPDev provisioned it); all four combinations are meaningful. Refused on the embedded engines (InMemory, H2Local), which have no server to be external.

strategy.description: STOR-16. `Ephemeral` discards this app's data on every start: NPDev drops the tables the manifest declares it owns and recreates them from the model, with no diff, no impact report and no acknowledgment token. `RecreateOnAppStart` is the DEPRECATED spelling of it -- still accepted, warned about at generation time, and rewritten by `npdev migrate db-lifecycle`. It never had a code path of its own; despite the name it recreated nothing.

ownership.description: REG-7.1. Optional, defaults to NpdevManaged (today's only behavior) when absent. ExternallyManaged means NPDev does not own this database's schema: it never issues DDL, only verifies compatibility at boot.

allOf.comment: STOR-16. `Ephemeral` must be declared, not merely selected. The exact confirmation STRING and the scope are engine-dependent (a physical engine takes I_UNDERSTAND_ALL_DATA_IS_DELETED_ON_EVERY_START + NpdevOwnedTablesOnly; InMemory also accepts the pre-existing I_UNDERSTAND_INMEMORY_DATA_IS_EPHEMERAL + NpdevOwnedLogicalStoresOnly pair it already carries), and this schema cannot see the engine from inside schemaLifecycle -- so it pins the part that is unconditional and SchemaLifecyclePolicy.ephemeralConfirmedFor enforces the rest at generation time with an engine-specific message.
